record.hypothesis: Use softplus(neg_score-pos_score) + 0.2*[softplus(-pos_score)+softplus(neg_score)], averaged over existing nonpadding targets. The pairwise term maintains ranking pressure while pointwise supervision constrains score drift. Earlier improvement with unnormalized embeddings motivates testing this objective on the current unit-normalized incumbent. Preserve embeddings, GRU architecture, readout, scoring, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings across all four datasets, with one checkpoint per category.
record.diff_excerpt:
--- 
+++ 
@@ -156,5 +156,10 @@
     pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
     mask = (pos != 0).float()
-    loss = -torch.log(torch.sigmoid(pos_scores - neg_scores) + 1e-8)
+    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
+    pointwise_loss = (
+        torch.nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores)
+        + torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    )
+    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
     return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
